_source: ADR 4.3.5 — special provisions for ADR tanks (API field: adrTankSpecial, Table A column 13). TU codes (general provisions concerning the substance/filling) and TE codes (provisions concerning equipment — not encountered in the source, presumably located elsewhere in the treaty, outside the scope of the sample record) — the full list of TU1–TU43 is reproduced here.

tu_codes.TU1: The tank may be handed over for carriage only after the substance has completely solidified and been covered with inert gas; empty uncleaned tanks — filled with inert gas.
tu_codes.TU2: Substance kept under inert gas; empty uncleaned tanks — filled with inert gas.
tu_codes.TU3: The inside of the shell and any fittings in contact with the substance must be kept clean; no lubricants that could react dangerously with the substance.
tu_codes.TU4: Substance kept under a layer of inert gas at ≥50 kPa gauge pressure during carriage; empty uncleaned tanks — likewise filled with inert gas at ≥50 kPa.
tu_codes.TU6: Substances with an LC50 ≤200 ppm — carriage in tanks, battery-vehicles and MEGCs prohibited.
tu_codes.TU7: Sealing/preserving compounds used on closures must be compatible with the contents.
tu_codes.TU8: Aluminium-alloy tanks prohibited, unless reserved exclusively for such carriage and the acetaldehyde is acid-free.
tu_codes.TU9: UN 1203 petrol (vapour pressure at 50°C of 110–150 kPa) may be carried in tanks meeting 6.8.2.1.14(a) and 6.8.2.2.6.
tu_codes.TU11: Filling temperature ≤60°C (up to 80°C permitted if overheating is prevented); pressure leak-tightness test after filling; no vacuum permitted during carriage; pressure checked before discharge (inert gas if needed).
tu_codes.TU12: When the tank's use is changed, the shell and equipment must be completely cleaned of residues before and after carriage.
tu_codes.TU13: Tanks must not be contaminated during filling; external equipment (valves, pipework) must be emptied after filling/discharge.
tu_codes.TU14: Protective covers on closures must be fitted during carriage.
tu_codes.TU15: Tanks must not be used for the carriage of foodstuffs, other consumer goods, or animal feed.
tu_codes.TU16: Empty uncleaned tanks require a protective agent (nitrogen, or water plus nitrogen filled to 96–98% with a non-corrosive antifreeze added); the tank must be filled with nitrogen so that pressure does not fall below atmospheric after cooling, and closed tightly.
tu_codes.TU17: Carriage only in battery-vehicles or MEGCs with elements/receptacles.
tu_codes.TU18: Degree of filling limited so that, at the temperature at which the safety valves open, the liquid does not exceed 95% of the tank's capacity; 4.3.2.3.4 does not apply.
tu_codes.TU19: Filling up to 98% at the filling temperature/pressure; 4.3.2.3.4 does not apply.
tu_codes.TU21: Protective agent per table: nitrogen (filling ≤96%), water plus nitrogen (≤98%, water layer ≥12 cm, water with antifreeze added); degree of filling at 60°C must not exceed the values given.
tu_codes.TU22: Filling ≤90% of capacity; at a mean liquid temperature of 50°C — 5% ullage.
tu_codes.TU23: Filling by mass ≤0.93 kg/l or by capacity ≤85%.
tu_codes.TU24: Filling by mass ≤0.95 kg/l or by capacity ≤85%.
tu_codes.TU25: Filling by mass ≤1.14 kg/l or by capacity ≤85%.
tu_codes.TU28: Filling ≤95% of capacity at a reference temperature of 15°C.
tu_codes.TU29: Filling ≤97% of capacity; maximum temperature after filling ≤140°C.
tu_codes.TU30: Filling per the type-approval test report, but ≤90% of capacity.
tu_codes.TU35: Empty uncleaned tank-vehicles/demountable tanks/tank-containers are not subject to ADR if steps have been taken to eliminate any hazard.
tu_codes.TU36: Degree of filling at a reference temperature of 15°C ≤93% of capacity.
tu_codes.TU37: Carriage in tanks limited to pathogens that do not pose a serious hazard (moderate individual risk, low community risk, treatment/prevention available).
tu_codes.TU39: The substance's suitability for carriage in tanks must be demonstrated (method approved by the competent authority, e.g. the Series 8(d) test); the substance must not be left for a period that risks caking.
tu_codes.TU40: Carriage only in a battery-vehicle/MEGC with seamless elements/receptacles.
tu_codes.TU41: The substance's suitability for carriage in tanks must be demonstrated to the competent authority of each country involved (approved method, with possible recognition of non-ADR approvals under conditions); the substance must not be left for a period that risks setting/thickening.
tu_codes.TU42: Aluminium-alloy tanks (including lined ones) — only for substances with pH 5.0–8.0.
tu_codes.TU43: An empty uncleaned tank may be handed over for carriage up to 3 months after the expiry of the lining's test date, for the purpose of undergoing another test before being refilled (see TT2 in 6.8.4(d)).

_note: TE codes (equipment) were not encountered in the analysed source excerpt (the sample record for UN 1658 had only TU15 and TE19 in the adrTankSpecial field, but the TE catalogue itself was not directly included in the available material) — if needed, this requires supplementing from the full ADR text, Chapters 4.3.5/6.8.4.
